name: RSSB
recent: Rivertree STF Synergies 于2026年11月提出收购 CLQ 运营商 Q Centre Management 的股权，此前于8月26日召开的特别股东大会通过三项议案，包括以现金收购 Rivertree Landmark 和 Rivertree Signatures 全部股权，以及出售 Irama Setia 全部股权。执行董事 Dato' Leong Sai Mun 在11月12日及13日于闭市期內增持公司股份。
notable: 该公司为外劳宿舍（CLQ）运营商。
2026年8月26日特别股东大会通过以现金 RM32,717,000 收购 Rivertree Landmark 100% 股权。
2026年8月26日特别股东大会通过以现金 RM13,571,000 收购 Rivertree Signatures 100% 股权，以及出售 Irama Setia 100% 股权。
risks: 执行董事 Dato' Leong Sai Mun 于2026年11月12日及13日在闭市期內增持股份。
公司于2026年11月11日及12日发布多项企业提案公告，具体条款及影响需留意后续披露。

recent_en: Rivertree STF Synergies proposed in November 2026 to acquire a stake in CLQ operator Q Centre Management and to diversify its business. An EGM on 26 August 2026 passed three resolutions, including cash acquisitions of 100% of Rivertree Landmark and Rivertree Signatures, and the disposal of 100% of Irama Setia. Executive Director Dato' Leong Sai Mun acquired shares on 12 and 13 November during the closed period.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of a stake in Q Centre Management, a centralised labour quarter (CLQ) operator, with a proposed business diversification.
EGM on 26 August 2026 approved the cash acquisition of 100% of Rivertree Landmark for RM32,717,000.
EGM on 26 August 2026 approved the cash acquisition of 100% of Rivertree Signatures for RM13,571,000 and the disposal of 100% of Irama Setia.
risks_en: Executive Director Dato' Leong Sai Mun acquired shares on 12 and 13 November 2026 during the closed period.
The company announced multiple corporate proposals on 11 and 12 November 2026; terms and impact require further disclosure.
